review: Exceptional noise cancellation! Perfectly blocks out ambient office noise and the battery lasts for days.
Decent sound quality, but the ear cups get a bit warm after wearing them for more than two hours.
The tactile key switches feel amazing to type on. Completely fixed my wrist fatigue during long coding sessions.
Solid build quality, but taking some time to get used to the split ergonomic layout.
Keeps water ice cold all day even in hot weather. Very durable finish with no leaks.
Great fitness tracking features, but the sleep tracking data feels slightly inaccurate at times.
Makes a superb morning cup of coffee. Easy to clean and looks beautiful on the countertop.
High quality leather and sleek design. Comfortably fits my laptop, charger, and daily essentials.
Very soft fabric, but it shrank slightly after the first wash. I recommend ordering one size up.
Surprisingly loud sound for its compact size. Perfect speaker for outdoor picnics and trips.
